newFeatures.title: Claude app sessions on the board
newFeatures.detail: See local Code sessions from the Claude desktop app in a folder-based Claude App column. Go to session opens the matching session and brings Claude forward.

newFeatures.title: cmux session support
newFeatures.detail: See cmux sessions together by folder. Go to session selects the matching workspace and terminal surface, then brings cmux forward.

newFeatures.title: Update from the Spyhop menu
newFeatures.detail: Choose Check for Updates… to review a new version’s complete release notes. Update and restart installs it and reopens Spyhop automatically.

newFeatures.title: Release notes after each update
newFeatures.detail: The version you just installed introduces all of its New Features and Fixes once. Release Notes in the Spyhop menu opens the latest published notes.

fixes.title: More reliable WezTerm switching
fixes.detail: Go to session raises the intended window even when tabs have custom names or windows share a title, and restores temporary title changes afterward.

fixes.title: cmux detection and Korean locale handling
fixes.detail: Recognize cmux before its embedded Ghostty identity, support current and legacy surface identifiers, and keep process discovery reliable with Korean system output.

fixes.title: Readable text on state colors
fixes.detail: Buttons, step numbers and selected controls choose readable text colors across light and dark themes.

fixes.title: Consistent Full reply scrollbars
fixes.detail: Expanded replies, code blocks and tables use the same scrollbar style as the board.

fixes.title: Header alignment
fixes.detail: The state legend and last-update time stay at the right edge when an update notice appears. The Settings gear sits closer to the window’s right edge.
